instagram:
Is WhatsApp Business free? App haan, par do baatein koi nahi batata. Broadcast bheja aur aadhe logon tak pahuncha hi nahi. Galat tareeke se bheja to poora number ban. 📵

1. App free hai, API nahi: Play Store wala WhatsApp Business app poora free hai. Hazaaron logon ko ek saath message bhejne wala API paid hai, wahan har message ka paisa lagta hai.

2. Broadcast ka rule: ek list mein zyada se zyada 256 log. Aur message sirf unhi ko jaata hai jinhone aapka number save kiya hai. Isliye har customer se kahiye, mera number save kar lijiye.

3. Asli nuksaan: anjaan numbers ko bulk message bhejenge to log block aur report karenge, aur WhatsApp aapka number ban kar sakta hai.

Save kar lijiye, agle broadcast se pehle kaam aayega. Comment mein bataiye, aapka broadcast kitne logon tak pahunchta hai? 👇
